rules: Fractions are structural measurement support only and never biological effect sizes.
A zero measured value is distinct from NOT_MEASURED.
NOT_MEASURED never contributes as numeric zero to downstream program activity.
Genome-build conversion requires a mapping receipt and may not be implicit.
A source-specific crosswalk does not authorize opening that source's protected biological outcome.
FULL104_HVS, FULL104_NPH52 and FULL104_SEA_AD are reported separately; a global FULL104 number cannot replace them.
NIH_CARD_STAGE4 structural eligibility does not modify the frozen primary Stage-4 estimand.
Perturbation support refers to target/regulator coverage, not whole-program causal validation.
Spatial support may be partial because of panel design and cannot be read as program absence.
mapping_receipt_requirements: gene identifier mapping receipt if namespace differs
region overlap/liftover receipt if coordinates/build differ
